title: "Projected pace" label is wrong for NFL, CFB, NHL, tennis and shows points total with a % vs league average nobody can check
steps: Open NFL game: "PROJECTED PACE 49.3 total (+12% vs league avg)"
expected: Sport-appropriate label (e.g. projected total points); no unsupported league-average comparison; none when MODEL is consensus-only
actual: NFL/CFB show "pace" (a basketball term); NHL says "goals"; figure presented as projection although no model ran; league average not shown.
